title: Card (1993) NLSYM returns-to-schooling IV/2SLS benchmark

source.name: Card (1993) / NLSYM data, redistributed as the linearmodels 'card' dataset (linearmodels.datasets.card)

estimator.name: IV/2SLS
estimator.spec: lwage ~ 1 + exper + expersq + black + smsa + south + [educ ~ nearc4]

diagnostics_definitional_notes.linearmodels: IV2SLS provides coefficients, SE, N, first-stage (individual) partial R2 / F. Overidentification Sargan is invalid here (equation exactly identified: 1 endogenous, 1 excluded instrument). linearmodels default summary does not expose Kleibergen-Paap / Sanderson-Windmeijer / Anderson-Rubin; these are NOT fabricated.
diagnostics_definitional_notes.ivreg2: ivreg2 (with homoskedastic VCE) reports first-stage F of excluded instruments, Sanderson-Windmeijer conditional F, Anderson canonical corr. LM (underidentification), Cragg-Donald / KP Wald F (weak identification), Stock-Wright LM S / Anderson-Rubin (weak-IV-robust), and Sargan (invalid here, equation exactly identified).
diagnostics_definitional_notes.comparison: Coefficients, SEs, and N are definition-compatible between linearmodels and ivreg2 under homoskedastic 2SLS and are STRICTLY compared. Diagnostic statistics are compared only when the same quantity and definition are produced by BOTH; otherwise documented as tool-specific, not forced to equality.

no_op: Does NOT promote any IV implementation to verified. Maturity follows frozen rules: genuine real-data benchmark + source fidelity + deterministic artifact mapping + provenance enforcement may justify tested for the exact demonstrated implementation/scope; synthetic tests alone never do.
